dds.boundary: AD9833 analog waveform/amplitude/phase accuracy/output impedance/0-0.6V are NOT RUN; only the register writes and the selected regs are asserted. The frozen driver's combined set_freq_phase()/quick_output() writes frequency+phase as a contiguous 6-byte burst at 0x30; the 0136 model only accepts a 4-byte frequency write at 0x30 and NACKs the trailing phase bytes, so this evidence uses the driver's separate set_freq()/set_phase()/set_mode()/set_ctrl() APIs and records the burst gap unresolved. The 0136 read-snapshot also overlaps frequency-register 1 at 0x34 with phase-register 0, so the guest 0x34 readback is recorded as a model-snapshot boundary; QOM phase-deg is still asserted from the accepted phase write.
